preconditions.description: The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 400000.
For each query, p and q must be between 1 and 10^18.
For type 1 queries, R must be a valid node index and W must be between 0 and 10^9.
For type 2 queries, R must be a valid node index and X must be between 0 and 10^15.

postconditions.description: The output for each type 2 query must be the last answer, which is the maximum length of the sequence.
At least one query of type 2 must exist, and the last answer can be 0.
